# AmneziaWG Apple (WireGuardKit)

Vendored subset of [amnezia-vpn/amneziawg-apple](https://github.com/amnezia-vpn/amneziawg-apple) (`v3.1.4`) for the Packet Tunnel.

Only `WireGuardKit`, `WireGuardKitC`, and `WireGuardKitGo` are included. Build `libwg-go.a` via the `WireGuardGoBridgeiOS` external target (requires Go on the Mac).
